text.description_html:
Matte Black 11-13/16 Inch Long Stainless Steel Flush Pull

The 11-13/16 Inch Black Flush Pull has a stunning matte black finish. Its sleek, rectangular shape makes this pocket door pull a must have for any contemporary home. Flush pulls like this one can be used in many applications including used as pocket door hardware or as cabinet pulls on lightweight drawers. This Matte Black 11-13/16 Inch Long Stainless Steel Flush Pull installs with the use of two screws (one at each end) for a secure fit.

Specifications for the 11-13/16 Stainless Steel Flush Pull in Black:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Total Height: 11-13/16" (300 mm)
  • Total Width: 2-3/16" (56 mm)
  • Total Depth: 1/2" (13 mm)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 7/16" (11 mm)
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)
  • Finger Opening Height: 10-5/8" (270 mm)
  • Finger Opening Width: 1-1/32" (26 mm)
  • Door Cutout Height: 11-9/16" (294 mm)
  • Door Cutout Width: 1-15/16" (50 mm)

*Sold Individually
